sites.name: Tan Trao Special National Historical Relic Site
sites.event: The Capital of the Liberated Zone, the Capital of the Resistance, where major historical events took place that decided the nation's destiny during the August Revolution.

sites.name: Tan Trao Banyan Tree
sites.event: The place where General Vo Nguyen Giap read Military Order No. 1, ordering the troops to march towards Hanoi (afternoon of August 16, 1945).

sites.name: Na Nua Shack
sites.event: The place where President Ho Chi Minh lived and worked from May to August 1945 to direct the General Uprising.

sites.name: Tan Trao Communal House
sites.event: The venue of the National Congress (predecessor of the National Assembly) on August 16, 1945, which elected the National Liberation Committee of Vietnam.

sites.name: Na Hang - Lam Binh Eco-tourism Area
sites.event: Likened to 'Ha Long on land' in the middle of the vast forest, famous for Tuyen Quang hydroelectric reservoir, Pac Ta Mountain, and Vai Pha pillar.

place.commune: Communes in Na Hang and Lam Binh districts
place.district: Na Hang District, Lam Binh District

sites.name: My Lam Mineral Spring
sites.event: A famous natural sulfur mineral water source, rated as one of the best mineral water sources in Indochina.

sites.name: Mac Dynasty Citadel (Tuyen Quang)
sites.event: A feudal military architectural relic built in 1592, witnessing many historical battles.

sites.name: Kim Binh Relic Site
sites.event: The venue of the 2nd National Congress of the Party (February 1951) - the first Congress to be held domestically.

sites.name: Mo Waterfall (Pac Ban Waterfall)
sites.event: A national scenic spot, a majestic waterfall associated with the legend of Mo, the wife of a young man who went to catch turtles.

sites.name: Ha Temple (Hiep Thuan Than Huong Linh Tu)
sites.event: A sacred temple dedicated to Mau Thuong Ngan (Princess Phuong Dung), associated with the legend of the two princesses, daughters of the Hung King.

sites.name: Ban Ba Waterfall
sites.event: A unique 3-tiered waterfall located in the middle of a primeval forest, featuring wild and poetic beauty.

sites.name: Hong Thai Communal House
sites.event: The communication station and the first stop of Uncle Ho when he returned from Pac Bo to Tan Trao (May 1945).
